chatlanes.config.title: ChatLanes – Settings
chatlanes.config.no_tabs: No tabs – add one with “+ New tab”.
chatlanes.config.edit.title: Edit tab
chatlanes.config.edit.name: Name
chatlanes.config.type.tooltip:
System: everything not assigned to a channel or PM tab.
Channel: messages matching the detection (first matching channel wins).
All: shows every message.
chatlanes.config.match.tooltip:
Tag: e.g. [G] – prefixes like [Server] before it are skipped.
Contains text: message contains the text anywhere.
Regex: regular expression for experts.
chatlanes.config.edit.value.tag.tooltip: The tag messages of this channel start with, e.g. [G]. Server prefixes like [Server] before it don't matter.
chatlanes.config.edit.value.regex.toolti: Regular expression on the message text without colors. Red = invalid.
chatlanes.config.edit.info.system: Receives everything no other tab matches.
chatlanes.config.prefix.tooltip: Put in front of your message when typing in this tab, e.g. “/g ”. Empty = send normally. Commands (with /) are never changed.
chatlanes.config.blink.tooltip: Tab blinks while it has unread messages.
chatlanes.config.edit.test.tooltip: Type an example chat line to check whether it would end up in this tab.
chatlanes.config.closed.tooltip: Whether the tabs are also shown while the chat is closed. “Only when unread” shows them while a blinking tab has unread messages.
chatlanes.config.unread_count.tooltip: Master switch for the unread count after tab names. Per channel under Edit → Counter.
chatlanes.config.history.tooltip: How many messages are kept in total (vanilla: 100). All tabs share this storage.
chatlanes.config.pm_close.tooltip: Closes all PM tabs when you leave the server.
chatlanes.config.pm_command.tooltip: What is sent when you type in a PM tab. {player} = player, {message} = your message, e.g. /msg {player} {message}. Commands (with /) are never changed.
chatlanes.config.pm_pattern.tooltip: Regular expression for private messages. The player name is in the group (?<player>…); more alternatives: (?<player2>…), (?<player3>…) etc.
chatlanes.config.pm_test.tooltip: Type a private message from the chat to test the detection.
chatlanes.config.pm_test.no_match: ✘ Not detected as a private message
chatlanes.config.general.title: General
chatlanes.config.pm.title: Private messages
chatlanes.config.fixed_size.tooltip: The open chat always uses its full height (Chat Settings → Focused Height), so the tabs always stay in the same place.
chatlanes.config.channels.title: Channel switching & history
chatlanes.config.switch_on_tab.tooltip: When you select a tab, its switch command (e.g. /ch global) is sent to the server so you write in that channel. Set the command per tab under “Edit”.
chatlanes.config.hide_confirm.tooltip: Optional: regular expression for the server's reply to the channel switch. Matching messages up to 3 seconds after a tab switch are hidden.
chatlanes.config.save_history.tooltip: Saves the messages of all tabs per server and restores them into the right tabs next time you join. “Max history” under General sets how many. Note: if another mod also saves chat messages, old messages appear twice.
chatlanes.config.delete_history.tooltip: Deletes the saved messages of all servers. The currently visible chat stays.
chatlanes.config.history_info: Saved for %s server(s)/world(s), up to %s messages each.
chatlanes.config.edit.switch.tooltip: Sent to the server when you select this tab so you write in that channel. Empty = send nothing.
chatlanes.config.counter.tooltip: Shows the number of unread messages in brackets after the name, e.g. “Global (3)”. Off = the name just turns yellow.
chatlanes.config.language.tooltip: Which language the mod uses for its texts. “Automatic” follows Minecraft's language setting.
chatlanes.config.sound.tooltip: Sound for new messages in this tab. No sound while you're viewing the tab with the chat open, or for your own messages. You hear the sound when switching.
chatlanes.config.timestamps.tooltip: Shows the time received before every message, e.g. “[14:05] [G] Player: Hi”. Applies to all tabs set to “Time: Default” – change per channel under Edit.
chatlanes.config.timestamp_mode.tooltip:
Time before the messages of this tab.
Default: as under General → “Time before messages”.
ON/OFF: always on or off for this tab.
chatlanes.config.extra.tooltip: Pull messages that would otherwise land in the System tab into this channel – e.g. everything containing “Info”.
chatlanes.config.extra.title: Additional messages for “%s”
chatlanes.config.extra.info: If a rule matches, the message goes here instead of System:
chatlanes.config.extra.also_system.toolt:
ON: the message appears in this channel AND in the System tab.
OFF: it is moved from the System tab to here.
chatlanes.config.extra.empty: No rules yet – add one with “+ Rule”.
chatlanes.config.extra.test.tooltip: Type a chat line that currently lands in the System tab to check the rules.
chatlanes.config.edit.value.command.tool: Everything that would land in the System tab after this command (time adjustable on the right) goes to this channel – e.g. the full output of /where. Several commands = several rules.
chatlanes.config.extra.test.command: Command output is detected when you run the command.
chatlanes.config.update_check.tooltip: When joining a world or server (once per game start), checks whether a newer version is on GitHub and tells you in the chat.
chatlanes.config.extra.seconds.name: Time
chatlanes.config.extra.seconds.tooltip: For this long after the command, everything that would land in the System tab goes to this channel (0.1 to 60 seconds). Shorter = fewer unrelated messages caught, longer = safer with a slow server.
chatlanes.config.default_tab.tooltip: This tab is selected every time the game starts. If you write there after logging in, the mod first switches to its channel (switch command).
chatlanes.config.auto_return.tooltip: Automatically switches back to the default tab if you haven't written anything in the current tab for this long. Only happens while the chat is closed.
chatlanes.search.title: Search chat
chatlanes.search.hint: Enter search terms (several words = all must appear)
chatlanes.search.scope.tooltip:
All tabs: search the whole saved chat history.
Current tab: only messages of the selected tab.
chatlanes.search.enter_text: Type a search term – click a result to jump there.
chatlanes.search.count: %s results – click to jump to the message
chatlanes.search.count_max: More than %s results – narrow your search
chatlanes.config.automation.title: Automation
chatlanes.config.peek: Briefly show System tab for replies
chatlanes.config.peek.tooltip: If something lands in the System tab shortly after a command or block click (e.g. LogBlock), the view jumps there and back afterwards. Your channel on the server stays the same.
chatlanes.config.peek.time.tooltip: How long the view stays in the System tab. More system messages extend the time. Returns only while the chat is closed.
chatlanes.config.peek.reaction.tooltip: Only system messages arriving this soon after your action trigger it.
chatlanes.config.peek.blocks.tooltip: Right/left clicks on blocks also count as an action – e.g. LogBlock lookups. Restrict to items in hand on the right.
chatlanes.config.peek.items.tooltip: Block clicks only count with these items in hand, e.g. oak_log or wooden_pickaxe. Use “Pick …” to choose from all items. Empty = any item.
chatlanes.config.peek.ignored.tooltip: These commands never jump to the System tab. Your tabs' switch commands are excluded automatically. Separate with commas.
chatlanes.config.peek.items.pick.tooltip: Opens a list of all items to click.
chatlanes.picker.title: Select items
chatlanes.picker.search: Search by name or ID, e.g. log or oak_log
chatlanes.config.profiles.button.tooltip: Every server has its own profile with its own tabs and settings. See all servers, turn ChatLanes on/off per server and edit profiles.
chatlanes.profiles.title: Server profiles
chatlanes.config.profiles.unknown.toolti: Whether ChatLanes is on for a server you join for the first time. The server always gets its own profile (copy of the default profile) that you can turn on later.
Used in singleplayer and as the template for new servers.
chatlanes.config.profiles.empty: No servers yet – join one and it shows up here.
chatlanes.config.profiles.enabled.toolti: ChatLanes on or off on this server. Off = the chat looks like vanilla Minecraft.
chatlanes.config.profiles.reset: Reset profile to the default profile
chatlanes.config.profiles.reset.confirm: Click again: really replace with a copy of the default profile
chatlanes.config.profiles.delete.current: The current server can't be removed
chatlanes.config.peek.replay.tooltip: Messages that arrive in your tab while the view is briefly on the System tab are shown again after returning – as if they had just arrived.
chatlanes.config.pm_switch.tooltip: When you send a private message yourself (e.g. /msg Name Hi), the mod switches to the tab @Name and creates it if needed. With /r it switches to your last conversation partner.
chatlanes.config.pm_switch.commands.tool: Private message commands on your server – the first word after it is the player name. Separate with commas.
